title: MZ Change texture of the selectable items' background in a window?

posts.author: AmeerAshourDraws
posts.body:
Hello there, recently I've been teaching myself how JavaScript works in RPG Maker MZ, and I've been screwing around with the UI's code. I've been able to do a lot, but I have a question that I'm not sure if it's possible in an easy way.
You know how the items in any selection window have a black background behind it? I was wondering if that could be replaced with a texture of my own. I'm not talking about changing its colors in the ColorManager, and the WindowSkin only changes the cursor, not the background. I'm talking replacing the basic black gradient background with a picture.
To give you an idea, I've been looking up custom menus made in other RPG Makers for some inspiration, and I've come across one of Moonpearl's custom XP menus and Galv's custom VX Ace themes.
Notice how the menu options and the character stats on the right have their own backgrounds as opposed to using the default item selection theme? I was wondering how to do a similar thing in MZ

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Don't know how to code that, but I think you can check how it's done from Hakuen Studio Background Manager or Moghunter Menu Background.

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
Technical:
Commands are drawn via the
drawItem
method inherited from
Window_Command
.
Item backgrounds are drawn via the
drawItemBackground
method inherited from
Window_Selectable
.
So you could use/write a plugin that overrides those methods for the applicable windows (
Window_MenuCommand
,
Window_MenuStatus
).
Note that, just like with Show Choices, setting a window's background type to 2 (Transparent) will also hide the window frame, like in your sample screenshots.
